name: Near-certain "bond" carry: pre-outcome 95-99.9c harvesting, settlement-discount curve, cash-crunch trades and holding rewards
one_line: Hold near-certain outcomes to resolution as zero-coupon bonds priced off the settlement-discount curve and a per-category flip hazard; layer the 3.25% holding reward (verified on complete YES+NO sets on-chain and in the Data API) and buy patience into cash crunches. Carry with a fat left tail, not arbitrage.
maturity: Established as a cash-management sleeve (median 6.22% APY for top bonding makers; +0.83c per dollar at >=0.90; whales park $3.4-5.0M complete sets at 3.25% and one $7.5M wallet runs a $2.5M near-certain NO book); decayed where safest (2028 neg-risk NO rungs 0.999 = 0.04%/yr); reward layer Emerging and discretionary
requires_ai: no; optional LLM rules screen for dispute hazard
edge: Impatient holders sell certainty below par; fee-free extremes; Treasury-funded 3.25% on inventory
capital: $1k-$10k runs (no fixed costs); meaningful only as a sleeve on $50k+ idle collateral; lock-up = horizon (33-846 days) plus 4-14 day dispute tail
build_time: 1-2 weeks on an existing sniping stack; 3-4 weeks solo from scratch
opportunity_size: Binary 45-120d rungs median 7.08% annualised (upper bound, includes real 5% outcomes); holding-reward pool ~$11.3k/day on ~$127M eligible; stable, discretionary
expected_results: 6.22% median APY (bonding); +0.83c/$ at >=0.90; 3.25% on sets verified to the cent; one live $2.5M near-certain NO book (lifetime PnL not attributable); guess net 2-6%/yr with negative years
competition: queue game at 0.998/0.999; whales in sets, crypto dip-to NO ladders and by-date NO books; thin in 45-300d binaries
flag: none; grey only if voting UMA on held markets; not for restricted persons
validate: backtest >=0.95 purchases with >=1 day to go by category vs flip rate; $1k complete-set pilot reconciled on-chain; frontier watch into midterms
top_risk: Break-even flip = discount; disputes cluster by news complex; reward rate cut at will
solo_fit_reason: Trivial to build, no speed race, hard data on every parameter, but it returns roughly the cash rate (2-6% a year net, 3.25% on sets) with fat tails, so it is a yield sleeve on inventory the team already holds rather than a business; the value for this owner is the verified complete-set carry (the only native equivalent of staking on Polymarket) and the frontier as a pricing input for their other bots.
speed_class: speed-insensitive: carry accrues over weeks; only the 0.998/0.999 turnover variant is queue-sensitive
min_capital: none technically; ~$50k+ idle collateral to matter
capacity_ceiling: tens of $k per binary rung at 5-10%; ~$4.1M/yr holding pool, capped at will
services: Polymarket Data API (positions/value/user-stats; v2 user-pnl intermittent: empty at 15:55, served at 16:04 UTC on 2026-09-28)
Polygon RPC (distributor transfers; public RPCs prune or refuse within a day, keep two providers)
changes_made: Category relabelled from Arbitrage to Directional trading (carry / risk premium) per critic note; break-even-equals-discount made explicit.

Complete-set eligibility for holding rewards verified on-chain: the $328.50 payout equals 3,689,354 x 0.0325/365; the verifier re-ran the 28 Sep payout query via Tenderly (48,256 transfers, $11,332.78, top five reproduced) and matched it to the Data API's yield_income ($21,147 accrued on that set since 2026-07-20).

Verifier corrected 'three of the five largest recipients are pure complete-set parkers' to two: the largest ($5.0M set) also holds $2.5M of near-certain NO on by-date markets, which is this file's strategy in the wild (2,134 trades, realised PnL +$2.08M lifetime, $64.6k yield income); added to Expected results with the attribution caveat.

Verifier corrected the claim that Data API v2 user-pnl 'returned empty for every wallet' to a transient outage (served full histories nine minutes later); services table and underestimating point 6 rewritten around intermittency and RPC pruning / 403s.

Live settlement-discount curve built from 7,013 markets (1,781 near-certain sides): 7.08% median at 45-120 d labelled an upper bound in three places; 2028 NO rung books and the two geopolitics examples re-checked unchanged.

Gebele & Matthes figures corrected to the paper's Table 6: per-trade profit $0.04-0.07 (was $0.040-0.048), per-provider median holds 0.76-2.00 h (was ~1.5 h); HN source id corrected to the comment (48008935, not the story 48007503); Cryptopolitan no longer credited with 'Treasury funded'; changelog note now mentions the 2026-08-10 redemption-reporting entry.

Post-outcome recycling step trimmed to a pointer to file 13; the staking cross-reference made explicit (holding rewards, not UMA staking, are the native equivalent); point 9 (venue-specific certainty) scoped to cross-venue hedges.
Holding rewards have no $1 floor: help article has no minimum and 47,269 of 48,256 recipients got under $1, so E2's 'five programmes with a $1 minimum' does not apply to this one.
open_doubts: Own 7.08% frontier includes genuinely uncertain 0.95-0.98 outcomes, so it overstates the risk-free wedge; no leakage-controlled realised-return backtest by category was run.

The $2.5M near-certain NO book's lifetime PnL (+$2.08M realised) mixes carry with large directional wins (biggest win $201.6k) and cannot be decomposed from public data; one top-5 holding-reward recipient (0x2c33) could not be reconciled with its positions.
Whether holding rewards survive the announced migration to a new reward and oracle-resolution system, and at what rate, is unknown; the help page lists 18 eligible events while Gamma flags 29.
Flip (not dispute) frequency by category is not measured anywhere public; the haircut uses dispute rates from a commercial page as a proxy.
